name: Queue
desc: A piece that allows you to push items into a queue, providing a way to throttle requests or process data in a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) manner.

actions.name: peek-queue
actions.description: Read the oldest items in a queue without removing them

actions.name: get-queue-size
actions.description: Count the items waiting in a queue

actions.name: clear-queue
actions.description: Clears all items inside a queue
